name: agent-board
description: File-based multi-agent task board for ZCode: agents in different conversations of the same project claim/submit tasks with atomic locking, plus parallel-worker support inside a single conversation.

description_i18n.en: File-based multi-agent task board for ZCode: agents in different conversations of the same project claim/submit tasks with atomic locking, plus parallel-worker support inside a single conversation.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 多 agent 任务看板：同一项目的多个对话通过原子锁接任务、提交任务、互相留言，并支持单对话内拆分并行 worker。
